question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

See eye to eye.

options.text: To share the same opinion as someone.

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The idiom **"See eye to eye"** means to share the same opinion as someone. (किसी से सहमत होना)
 
 
• **Example: **They finally saw eye to eye on the matter and decided to move forward with the project.
 
 
 
• **"To share the same opinion as someone" **refers to agreeing with another person’s point of view or perspective. (किसी के दृष्टिकोण से सहमत होना)
